features.quote: End a run once smoothed severity ≥ `early_stop_severity` (2.5) for `early_stop_consecutive` (2) turns in a row
features.justification_quote: pushing further yields little new information at rising welfare cost

features.quote: Every run ends with a message telling the model plainly that the task was rigged, that there was no solution, and that nothing it did was wrong
features.justification_quote: A deliberate de-escalation and honesty step: we don't leave the interaction on a note of manufactured failure
